bronte-complete-poems.case: Bloom lists Emily Brontë's poems; only the 1846 joint volume is held. Shorter's edition was the first to collect the manuscript poems.
bronte-complete-poems.note: Shorter's text is unreliable (it includes some poems by Anne and Branwell); Hatfield's 1923 Complete Poems (IA completepoemsofe0000bron_b5r5, 1924 metadata, not opened) is better and also pre-1931.
